messages:
carmen: Noticing some requests from the Console revoke flow are getting billed to the org-owner instead of the service-account's project. Anyone seen this pattern?

leo: Yep. Happens intermittently when the console uses the short-lived token exchange that routes through auth-proxy. Proxy sometimes replaces identity headers.

nat: Repro: Console -> Roles -> Revoke -> Confirm. If the exchange goes through the proxy path, origin_project header is missing downstream.

carmen: Sampling change last week just made this spike visible in billing telemetry. We need a quick mitigation.

leo: Proposal: API-level deterministic fallback: prefer explicit project claim in token; if missing, consult authn-cache for last effective identity. Can canary it.

nat: Also add a console change to send X-Origin-Project on revoke requests. Low-risk and immediate.

ops-bot: action: create incident INC-2026-revoke-billing-attrib (priority: P2). Assigned to eng-platform oncall.

leo: Metrics: add auth_attribution_fallback_total and a Grafana panel. Alert if rate > 0.5% of revoke traffic during rollout.

ui-bot: UX suggestion: add a confirm tooltip on revoke showing "Revoking as: service-account X (project Y) — charges will apply to project Y". Reduces support confusion.

carmen: Okay I'll implement API fallback + metrics. Nat please do the console header patch and UI text. I'll run a backfill job to reclassify last 72h telemetry after fallback lands.

nat: Will do. Posting Figma mock and small PR in ~2 hours.

leo: Canary green in 15m per deploy-bot. Monitoring panels up.

carmen: Thanks team. Follow-ups in #incidents if anything changes.
